scientific_integrity: The originating article owns the family, individual medial and Spearman formulas, and sufficient validity conditions. Novelty is asserted only for exact admissibility and joint attainable region. No independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Result restricted to the second polynomial trivariate copula of Chesneau (2024), with finite real parameters; no claim for all trivariate copulas. Historical priority provisional. Checker tests supplement a complete analytic proof.
title: Sharp dependence-region geometry of a nonexchangeable trivariate copula
